clubs.title: FOA clubs
clubs.intro: Start a lasting group of animal friends at your school or college, or join an approved club at your institution.
clubs.privacy: Club membership is private. Only the authorised institution and community team can see its member list. Do not enter anyone’s personal or contact details in a club name or decision note.
clubs.applyIntro: Choose your verified institution and propose a name. The community team reviews applications before approval.
clubs.name: Club name (required)
clubs.nameHint: Use 3–80 characters and a group name, not an individual’s name.
clubs.attestHint: If your affiliation is not already verified, this is your statement that you study or teach at the selected institution. It does not grant any institution role or access.
clubs.closed: Clubs are not open for new applications or joining yet.
clubs.noOptions: No eligible institution is available. Join the FOA community to apply with your own affiliation statement, or ask your institution about its verified registration.
clubs.count: {count, plural, one {# active member} other {# active members}}
clubs.joined: You are a member of this club.
clubs.adminIntro: Review applications, manage approved clubs and view private membership activity.
clubs.decisionHint: A private note for the applicant and the community team. Required when declining, suspending or closing; up to 1,000 characters.
